## FAQ

### What areas do you serve?
The greater Oklahoma City metro, including Edmond, Nichols Hills, Yukon, Moore and Norman. If you're nearby and don't see your town, call or text and ask.

### Do you clean commercial windows?
Yes. Complete Window Washing works with homes and businesses, including storefronts and offices.

### Do you clean inside and outside?
Yes. Interior and exterior window washing are both available, so the glass is clear from both sides.

### How do I get a quote?
Call or text (405) 437-4661. A photo or two of your windows helps us give you an accurate quote.

### How often should windows be cleaned?
Many homeowners book a cleaning once or twice a year, often in spring and fall. Storefront glass usually looks best on a more frequent schedule.

### What's the difference between window washing and window cleaning?
There isn't one. People use both names for the same service: getting your glass clean and streak-free, inside and out. Whichever you call it, Complete Window Washing does it for homes and businesses across the Oklahoma City metro.

### Do you offer recurring window cleaning?
Yes. You can book a one-time cleaning or set up recurring, year-round service for your home or business.

### Can you clean second- and third-story windows?
Yes, including hard-to-reach 2nd- and 3rd-story windows. Hard water stains, silicone, adhesive and concrete on glass can be removed too.

### Is professional window cleaning worth it?
If you have second-story windows, hard-to-reach glass, or you'd rather not spend a Saturday on a ladder, it usually is. A professional brings the right tools for a streak-free finish and gets it done safely. Call or text for a quote and decide from there.
